findings.invariant: Replayable or non-session-bound hello identity cannot acquire another account's durable peer-security namespace.
Account key revocation schema and handler use the same canonical key_id.
Validator lifecycle transitions share the future-epoch guard across all relevant paths.
Consensus-visible reputation/system payloads remain deterministic integer/fixed-point values and reject floats.
Equivocation evidence cannot synthesize an unauthorized automatic slash execution path.
Self-transfer cannot mint, duplicate, or distort balances/economic state.
Media/target mutation authority is checked against stored ownership/authorship.
Coarse ballot/dispute resolution cannot inherit arbitrary juror-supplied execution actions.
Scoped group operations verify stored group scope/authority rather than trusting caller-provided scope.
Treasury spend mutation/cancellation remains bound to the stored treasury scope.
Node-operator suspension is durable and scheduler/activation logic cannot silently reactivate a suspended operator.
User-created storage offers bind operator identity to the signer.
